item.title: [LAB-SEC-02] REST API Authentication & Header Security Audit
item.description:
Evaluating backend endpoints against missing security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options), improper CORS policies, and token leakage.
Domain: Defensive Security | Status: Active Lab Tools: Postman, Node.js, JWT Inspector, cURL Key Takeaway: Standardized defensive header practices and token expiration lifecycles on backend microservices.
Lab Syntax & Commands (bash): curl -i -X OPTIONS https://yeasin4745-dev.vercel.app/api/contact \ -H "Origin: https://yeasin-sec.vercel.app" \ -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: POST"
item.dc:creator: Yeasin
item.author: yeasin.devx@gmail.com (Yeasin)

item.title: RFC 9110: HTTP Semantics & Transport Evolution (HTTP/1.1 to HTTP/3)
item.description:
Analyzing stateless request-response mechanics, idempotency of methods, keep-alive connections, and QUIC over UDP.
Field: RFC & Protocol Study | Status: Deep Study References: IETF RFC 9110, Cloudflare Learning Guides
Reference Probe Syntax (bash): curl -Iv --http2 https://yeasin4745-dev.vercel.app/ -o /dev/null

item.title: OWASP API Security Top 10 Defensive Implementations
item.description:
Focusing on Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA), Broken Authentication, and Unrestricted Resource Consumption prevention.
Field: Network Defense | Status: Completed Analysis References: OWASP Foundation API Security Project
